note: Per-case wall-clock cost of one Autobahn case group, in seconds of `wstest` time. `planShards` multiplies this by the group's case count, so a group whose case count changes is re-priced without editing this file.
provenance: The framing groups cost the same per case because the suite's cost is a per-case constant inside the Python client: two runs of the same job took 2086s for the 301 framing cases and 2100s for all 517, so the 216 per-message-deflate cases account for 14s between them, about 0.065s each against 6.93s for a framing case. The per-group case counts are derived from the suite's own case expansion and are cross-checked against the two totals the repository already asserts independently: the nine framing groups sum to 301, which is TOTAL_CASES minus COMPRESSION_CASES, and groups 12 and 13 are the 5 and 7 deflate parameter sets over 18 size rows. A run's summary.json republishes both the measured per-case durations and the realised case counts, so this table can be re-derived from a measurement rather than from a derivation.
units: seconds of wstest time per case
